text: A very short game, seeing as I finished the main story in only about 2 hours - but that isn't to say its not enjoyable. It has some jank to it albeit rather minor but if you like Hotline Miami and brainless fast-paced gameplay this is it. I personally really love the artstyle and the soundtrack is banging. 7/10

If climatepunk isnt a genre it is now. The world sucks, the fascists and corpos won, this is what awaits us. The mystery element is just a tool to get you from obscene set piece to obsecene set piece. We have corpo masquerades, Incels have taken over the abandoned mall, and the local PI has Irritable Bowel Syndrome and is very open about it. 

Go in with an open mind and enjoy the ride. If you like social commentary in video game form, storytelling with a unique twist, and just an overall MOOD that is unmatched, play this game.

The devs also seem cool, and you gotta support the cool developers out there. To the Dev's best of luck on your future endeavors, you got a new true believer.

When you let story tellers work in peace...what a story you will get. Every thread. Every detail accounted for.

What a game. What a series.

You think you have free will in this life until a virtual 20-sided die decides your entire destiny. 

Still, where else can you miss a 99% hit on a sleeping goblin but successfully gaslit a demon lord into committing suicide? Best game ever.

It's like Resident Evil, if it was a horror game.

Thought the graphic violence and gore would be too much at the start. It still is, but it fits the themes and the story so it doesn't feel out of place. Was nice to see such a bold approach. It has a nice and steady progression and just keeps getting better. Just the combat at the beginning was slow before you unlocked other stuff and the achievement system is a bit funny.

"From the creators of Gris" is enough of a reason to recommend Neva, in all honesty. This game is an elegy for what is lost, a testament to what can still be found between despair & hope, all while exploring the essence of parenthood in a world that is filled with both ethereal beauty & haunting horrors. While the gameplay of Neva may lack depth, its true strength lies in its artistic expression. This truly is one of the most beautiful & emotional journeys you will get to experience while playing a game!
The graphics in this game is phenomenal. Even though it is  a 2013 game , it still holds up. The game is worth playing considering its very cheap on sales .

5 hours in and my mind is blown. Pls play thx

Edit: 100% my main save. Will be going for Ending C and NG+ in the future. 

10/10

Edit 2: Finished Ending C and DLC. 20/10 would blasphemy again

Beautiful game. I don’t care about people complaining that it’s short or not worth buying. Quality > Quantity. I still recommend waiting for a sale but in my case this game hit me hard and felt special. I saved up for a few months to buy it and I got it just 10 days before its first sale. I could have refunded it but I didn’t even bother because I felt completely fulfilled that’s what these rare games do. And Pragmata is definitely one of those games.

Seriously underrated and suffering from the same handicap most metroidvania games these deal with: hollow knight comparisons. 
The world is large and fun to explore with beautiful visuals and a muted, but still very solid solid sound track. I think the character/enemy designs are interesting. The platforming elements are fun, and it feels very rewarding solving the puzzles. I do have a few issues with the combat--it feels a little clunky at times--but the movement makes up for it for the most part. The boss fights are not too difficult, making it feel more like a fun, exploration game. 

Overall, I had a lot of fun.

Instead of "The Thing - In Space", it's more of a stealth game with few good ideas. The only part I really liked was the setting itself and contacting the crew members and see how they respond. 

Sadly, it's another horror game ruined by bad gameplay and a mediocre story.

It is intersting take on diablo, with some Dark Souls mechanics. 
It can be a little junky at times (using teleport with kbm is not really convinient). And itemisation could be a bit wider (only 4 types of weapons). But, overall, it is a good game, totally deserving it asking price. 

Not too long, and not too short. I hope sales are good enough for developers to make part 2. I just hope we would not fight Hades in the next game, dude done nothing wrong. 

P.S. Although, developers warn you, several times, to use gamepad instead of mkb, it's not really any problem. I finished the game without any problem, or tweaking with controlls using keyboard and mouse.

Super Meat Boy will make you question your life choices, your reaction time and possibly your monitors structural integrity. The controls are so tight it almost feels unfair that you keep dying. Almost. Each death is 100% your fault and deep down you know it, which somehow makes finally clearing a level feel absolutely incredible. It's the kind of game where dying 300 times on a single stage is just called a Tuesday. If you enjoy masochism with a side of dopamine, this is your game.
[8.5/10]

This game is amazing. It's like being the Silver Surfer in Okami/Windwaker with mechanics from Skate. The art style is unique and cool, and exploration is legit and doesn't feel like a trite collectathon - you're rewarded for just blasting around and doing cool tricks and trying to make difficult jumps, or dropping off ledges you notice etc. Quad AAAA game. I'm going to get the other games they made after playing this eventually.

Overall: simple, fun, polished game. Easy to beat, hard to complete (100% achievements).

I hope the dev add some more mechanic to the magic, for example like in dark messiah when enemy run on ice surface they slip.

I have played a lot of Mega Man, Mega Man X, and platformers in general. This is legitimately one of the best I have ever had the honor of playing. The controls are tight, responsive, and moving around is such a pleasure. This is the most fun I've had with a fighting robot in a very long time.

My one, very minor gripe - the run button is mapped to left trigger by default, and I was struggling with just holding it down all the time until I read on the forums that there's a toggle to keep it on all the time. DO THIS RIGHT AWAY IF THE GAME FEELS SLOW OR WEIRD - it sent this game from a 8-9/10 to a 10/10 for me. Everything's just so much more fluid AND my finger doesn't hurt from holding the trigger down.
my only complaint is that it is too short. have more cases for the duck detective to solve please! he needs the money to afford that sweet sweet bread.
Although some things had been changed, it's still good old Half-Life. Xen now is longer, way more immersive and just stunning. This is how remakes should be done.
